name: Floating Material -The Hill Where the Star Born.-
original_name: Floating Material （フローティング マテリアル） -The hill where the star born.-
source:
Shun is the only male teacher at Kyoukasen Girls’ School, a well-known high class school also known as the “Water School” since it is situated in a forest and there is a lake on the school grounds. It is a place to heal the wounds of those girls who are hurt. He meets girls who shut off themselves from the world, those who don’t have confidence in themselves, those who are still traumatized by their past. He decides to help them move forward with their lives.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/03/08/march-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
俊是贵族名校“镜华泉女子学园”里唯一的男教师。由于学园坐落于森林之中，校内又有一片湖泊，因此亦被称为“水之学园”——这里是一处抚平受伤少女心灵创伤的港湾。在这里，俊邂逅了封闭心门、缺乏自信，或是至今仍走不出过往阴影的少女们，并决心帮助她们重新迈步走向未来。

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/03/08/march-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
